race.title: Bill Halley Outstanding Contribution Award 2026 Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
race.verdict: A few with chances but THE DUCKS WALK signalled he is ready to go in again when an excellent runner-up in a big-field handicap at Punchestown recently so gets the vote. Johnny Cakes didn't enjoy the rub of the green when third at Limerick last time and rates a big threat off a handy-looking mark, while El Arco and Talas Kera appeal as the pick of the rest for minor honours. THE DUCKS WALK (IRE) JOHNNY CAKES (FR) EL ARCO (IRE)
